content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to keep the backlight on the main display continuously, either with a program or via settings?
Hi, Unfortunately, this feature is not available.

Hello, This is only achievable by modifying the hardware of the [product_name] and involves risks without any warranty. A solution has been shared in the German part of the forum in a document called [document]. The method involves connecting two wires (marked red in the image) inside the [product_name] basic module and routing them outside. You could use an external switch or a relay to control the backlight ON/OFF. Still, it is recommended to control the ON-time using the circuit and a key, rather than keeping the LEDs ON permanently. Best regards, [user_name]
Dear [user_name], Let's wait for the release of the new version of [product_name] before making changes. Best regards,

Is the following correct? Connect the two pads shown with the red line, attach wires to pads as indicated by yellow lines, drill a hole in the PCB, and route the wires outside of the [product_name]. Then connect the wires to a suitable external switch. Are there any concerns, such as thermal issues, with using all three pads for a permanent backlight connection?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to maintain continuous backlight on the main display of the [product_name]. Early replies clarify that neither software nor standard settings allow this, and attempts would require unsupported hardware changes carrying no warranty. Newer product revisions seem to offer this feature, but precise information remains unclear, leading to user uncertainty and showing that product capabilities have evolved.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to provide an option for keeping the backlight permanently on, either through settings or programmatic control.
